title: Assurances Published with the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
Four assurances are published with each plan of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: the period within which an invoice may be disputed, the period for which the network guarantees its own work, the time within which the inspection report reaches the host, and the size of the workshop network open to the plan. The report is measured in business days; the dispute and warranty periods in calendar days.

| Plan | Invoice may be disputed within (calendar days) | Work guaranteed for (calendar days) | Inspection report reaches the host within (business days) | Workshops in the network |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 14 | 90 | 3 | 1200 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 21 | 180 | 2 | 1800 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 30 | 365 | 2 | 2400 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 30 | 365 | 1 | 2400 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 45 | 365 | 1 | 2400 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 30 | 365 | 2 | 900 |

### Points of judgement on the assurances

*Which plans guarantee work for a full year.* Four of them: the Keyturn Care Complete, Turnaround, Fleet and Electric Plans all guarantee work for 365 calendar days. The Keyturn Care Routine Plan guarantees 180 and the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan 90.

*Whether the size of the network follows the monthly fee.* It does not. The Keyturn Care Electric Plan opens the smallest network of the six, 900 workshops, below the 1200 open to the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan, although its monthly fee is the higher of the two. Three plans share the largest network of 2400.

*How long a host has to dispute an invoice.* Between 14 calendar days on the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan and 45 on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, with 21 on the Keyturn Care Routine Plan and 30 on each of the remaining three.
